description: Two packages report greenhouse-gas observations from facilities. One XLSX summary covers 2015–2017 under the Specified Gas Emitters Regulation, in tonnes of carbon-dioxide equivalent, and describes required intensity reductions relative to approved facility-specific baselines. Its description states that the regulation expired December 31,2017. The other lists a facility-emissions XLSX for 2004–2016 under the Specified Gas Reporting Program. These regulatory reporting populations are kept distinct; no reporting threshold or continuity between programmes is inferred. The group is separate from municipal emission aggregates, with unverified row-level correspondence. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
